
ANSWER-QUESTION
Answer a question from Example Mapping and optionally convert to rule or assumption

USAGE
  fspec answer-question <workUnitId> <index> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <index> (required)
    Question index number (from show-work-unit)

OPTIONS
  --answer <answer>
    The answer text
  --add-to <type>
    Add answer to: rule, assumption, or none (default: none)

EXAMPLES
  1. Answer question
  $ fspec answer-question AUTH-001 0 --answer "Yes, support Google OAuth"
  ✓ Answered question: "Should we support OAuth?"
  Answer: "Yes, support Google OAuth"

  2. Answer and add as rule
  $ fspec answer-question AUTH-001 0 --answer "Email required" --add-to rule
  ✓ Answered question and added to rules

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-question
  fspec add-rule
  fspec add-assumption
